effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] All of your black Digimon with 13000 DP or more gain ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.).
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon is black and has 13000 DP or more, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
